scenes.text: Find the operation connecting consecutive terms. Use the same step to extend the sequence and justify it.
Continue: 7, 17, 27, ... What is term 7? The answer is 67. Term 7 is 7 plus 6 times 10 equals 67.
The values 6, 9, 12 describe a pattern at a school fair. What is the value at step 6 (counting the first as step 1)? Pause the video and think.
The values 6, 9, 12 describe a pattern at a school fair. What is the value at step 6 (counting the first as step 1)? The answer is 21. Term 6 is 6 plus 5 times 3 equals 21.
